posts.post_caption:
Want to train and deploy open-source LLMs on your own hardware without getting lost in complex documentation? 🚀

Building custom AI models often feels daunting—high API costs, hardware incompatibility, and scattered tutorials make it hard for students and developers to get started.

Meet **self-llm** by Datawhalechina—a comprehensive, beginner-friendly cookbook tailored for fine-tuning and deploying leading open-source LLMs and MLLMs in Linux environments! 🤖

✨ What makes this repository stand out:
• **Extensive Model Zoo**: Complete Jupyter Notebook tutorials for Llama 3, Qwen 2, GLM-4, InternLM2, MiniCPM, Gemma, and more.
• **Full & LoRA Fine-Tuning**: Clear, reproducible workflows for efficient parameter tuning on customized datasets.
• **Cross-Platform Hardware Support**: Dedicated modules for NVIDIA GPUs, Huawei Ascend NPU, Apple Silicon (MLX), AMD ROCm, and Muxi platforms.
• **Real-World Examples**: Hands-on projects like Chat-甄嬛 (roleplay agent) and Tianji (social etiquette AI with RAG & agents).

Whether you are an NLP student, researcher, or developer aiming to build domain-specific private LLMs, this repository lowers the barrier to entry significantly.

⭐ **32k+ Stars** | 📄 **Apache-2.0 License**

Which open-source model are you planning to fine-tune first? Let us know in the comments! 👇
